title: Meqheleng, Ficksburg (approx.): Mophinia Molise, 49, found dead in a yard; man, 22, charged with murder and rape, 25 Oct

story: The body of Mophinia Molise, 49, from Meqheleng near Ficksburg, was found lying in a yard near a house in Zone 2, Meqheleng, at about 08:00 on Sunday 25 October, according to police. Police say the body was covered with a blanket and she had a severe open wound to the throat; her husband, who had last seen her at a local tavern on Saturday night, found her. A 22-year-old man was arrested on Sunday evening and charged with murder and rape, and was due in the Ficksburg Magistrate's Court on 27 October; police say a post-mortem confirmed sexual assault and a case of rape and murder is being investigated. An arrest is not a conviction, and the accused is not named. One source, the SAPS Free State statement of 27 October. The date is when she was found; when she died is not given. The map point is the Meqheleng township point, not the yard.
incident: Body found Sun 25 Oct 2026 at about 08:00 (police). She was last seen at a tavern on Saturday night, 24 Oct; the time of death is not given.
